'''Ges-Su-Kai''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Ges-Su-Kai is only mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in a letter that he sends to Consular characters if the player picks the dark side option at the end of the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] class mission. If that happens, Master [[Syo Bakarn]] assigns Ges-Su-Kai to investigate [[Eriz Vossan]]'s research about the primary successful traits of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] culture. In the light side option, the research is destroyed instead.
